preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 10**16 for n in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query n is an integer between 1 and 10^16 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and line.strip().isdigit() for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a string representing a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == s_sequence[queries[i] - 1] for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, the output is the n-th element of the sequence s, where s is generated by repeatedly appending the lexicographically smallest triple (a, b, c) of positive integers not yet in s such that a XOR b XOR c equals 0.
